status: MEASURED exploratory cold-process and source-to-test-runnable pilot; M8 NOT YET ACHIEVED

manifest.scope: Exploratory cold native process pilot, not steady-state or app sweep
manifest.protocol: 3 independent measurement processes; 10 counterbalanced paired trials per case and target; 2 warmups; identical canonical BF bytes; output+exit validation each run; process creation, loading, reset, computation, stdin/stdout and termination included. No overhead subtraction. Fixed clocks/controlled thermals absent. Full compile timing separate from warm stage instrumentation. All RAM and energy unmeasured. No winner until missing gates satisfied.
manifest.comparison_family: Each competitor/target process-time GM, 3 clusters; simultaneous Bonferroni bootstrap intervals across 3 comparator/target arms exploratory only.
manifest.exclusions: No EOF reads, pointer failures, excessive output or nontermination in scored cases; these runtime profiles are not globally equivalent. Per-input compatibility only.

environment.clang: Android (13624864, based on r530567e) clang version 19.0.1 (https://android.googlesource.com/toolchain/llvm-project 97a699bf4812a18fb657c2779f5296a4ab2694d2)
environment.build_host: Windows x86-64 for both targets; Android execution on Pixel 8 Pro
environment.controls: Serial benchmark jobs; no fixed clocks, affinity or controlled thermals; Windows background services retained; same build host. Cold refers to process initialization, filesystem/OS caches warm after warmups.

compiler_flags.brainfry_android: same compiler, bfnative --target linux-aarch64; raw syscall executable actually run on Android
compiler_flags.bbc: pinned native BBC; pinned native canonical importer; unchanged legacy XAX verify_store and native lowerers; no new XAX implementation

limitations: Native steady-state runtime NOT MEASURED; full application invocation NOT MEASURED
Peak simultaneous process-tree compiler RAM and runtime RAM NOT MEASURED; energy NOT MEASURED
BBC output requires fixed generic test host; this is not Android APK or Windows application packaging latency

Artifact bytes: BBC module plus one copy of host per standalone workload, versus baseline standalone executable; OS system libraries excluded equally, no debug/static symbol tables; module/host bytes separate
Only 12 programs, 3 categories, one input per source, 3 holdouts. Three real app integrations and 20-program full-suite coverage absent
Profiles globally incompatible; no EOF/bounds/output-overflow/nontermination cases speed-ranked
Awib Rust/C-Clang alternate Windows modes and Brainfry JIT not fully benchmarked, so no best-mode sweep claim
Only 3 run clusters; bootstrap intervals exploratory and conservative Bonferroni family 32; family expanded from original manifest count after Android Brainfry execution verified
No BBC or XAX executable implementation changes in this benchmark iteration; external tools only; XAX legacy Python remains unchanged
Seeded randomized arm ordering, not forced equal counts; original manifest wording counterbalanced was imprecise.

The outer common Python CLI is measurement orchestration for the baselines. Its cost is retained in the test-pipeline figure, not credited as a competitor compiler requirement. Inner intervals are separate observations, not overhead-subtracted outer samples. Neither boundary is promoted to the final compiler victory gate.
Runner is a local pinned Git repository, not yet publicly published; independent published reproduction is still pending.
